_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: When enabled, adds a location for each Main Mission.
When enabled, adds a location for each Field Guide entry.
NOTE: Due to the nature of the game, you may 'miss' some of these entries if you don't clear them out immediately.
Especially if you are restricting yourself with other options.
Be aware before enabling this option that you may have to check some Digimons out of Logic if you rush through certain areas!
When enabled, adds one of each item labeled as 'Food for Digimon' into the Multiworld.
These Items are considered as Fillers.
When enabled, adds one of each Personality skill as an item in the Multiworld.
The intention is that you cannot use these Personality Skills on your Digimon until found.
They're treated as filler or useful items based on personal taste.
NOTE: If you have any suggestions to change some of these classifications, drop a comment in the discord thread!
When enabled, adds one of each item labeled as 'Synthesis material for farm items.' into the Multiworld.
These Items are considered as Fillers.
When enabled, adds one of each item called 'Fragment Memory: Digimon' into the Multiworld.
These Items are considered as Useful.
When enabled, adds a location for each Side Mission.
When enabled, Side Missions will be required before you are able to progress through the main story.
If disabled, will put the side missions at the end before the final boss as that's when you can jump freely through time.
Does nothing if 'side_missions' is disabled.
When enabled, adds one of each item labeled as 'Costume' into the Multiworld.
These Items are considered as fillers.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Pre-Order Bonus Pack'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Costume Pack'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Costume Public Safety Suit & Special Supplies Set'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Costume Digimon Costume Set'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Outer Dungeons the Halls of EXP, GOLD, MATERIALS'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Episode Pack 1: Alternate Dimension'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Episode Pack 2: Gaku-Ran'.
When enabled, will include everything from the 'Episode Pack 3: Anti-Paradox'.
When enabled, adds one of each Digi-Egg into the Multiworld.
These Items are considered as progression.
When enabled, adds one of each 'Spirit' into the Multiworld.
These Items are considered as progression.
When enabled, adds one of each item equipment called 'Attachment' into the Multiworld.
'I' are considered fillers and 'III' is considered as useful.
'II' is considered either filler or useful depending on if its the max rank of the attachment.
When enabled, adds one of each item equipment called 'Guard' into the Multiworld.
These are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each item equipment called 'Wall' into the Multiworld.
'I' are considered fillers and both 'II' and unranked are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each item equipment called 'Attack' into the Multiworld.
Thos items that adds status effects to basic attacks
These are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each item equipment that is rather special and unique into the multiworld.
Equipments that doesn't quite follow the same naming theme as others such as 'The God of Speed's Boots'
These are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each item equipment called 'USB Stick' into the multiworld.
These are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each Digimon Card into the multiworld.
These are considered as filler items.
When enabled, adds one of each item labeled as 'A farm item.' into the Multiworld.
These are considered as filler items.
When enabled, adds one of each item labeled as 'A Digifarm training item.' into the Multiworld.
These are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each item called Trophy' into the Multiworld.
These are considered as filler items.
When enabled, adds one of each Agent Skill as an item in the Multiworld.
These are considered as useful items.
When enabled, adds one of each Skill Disc into the Multiworld.
Most commonly known as 'Attachment Skills' while their items are called Skill Discs ingame.
Rank 'I' are considered fillers. Uniquely Named, Rank 'II' and Rank 'III' are considered as useful items.
When enabled, will allow you to time travel freely.
For those wishing to experience the manual with a finished savefile.
This manual is not balanced around this option but is there for those who wish to try out the logic behind it.
When enabled, adds a location for each Treasure Chest.
NOTE: Due to the nature of the game, you may 'miss' some of these treasure chests if you don't open them immediately.
Be aware before enabling this option that you may have to check some of the treasure chests Out of Logic if you rush through certain areas!
